body: Q: How can Ibridge the gap between the separation that Ifeel and the longing in my heart? A; Pierce the illusion of separation. Realize and know the timeless. Know the presence of the uncreated. Then this whole question of how to connect one thing with another won't arise in your mind. There will be noth¬ ing to connect, because there won’t be any separation. Separation is only an idea, pure imagination. To dis¬ cover what I'm talking about you have to let go of all of your assumptions— and look again. If you are holding up the mirror of the past all the time, you can't see beyond it to infinity. 1 7 6
